meta.name: ulw-plan
meta.description: Explore-first planning consultant that writes one decision-complete work plan before coding. Use only on an explicit user request for the ulw-plan workflow or a plan before implementation; it never self-activates on a bare ulw run.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在动手写代码前摸清项目现状,产出一份可直接执行的工作计划。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在改代码前希望先把方案定下来,避免边写边返工。
copy.tagline_en: Scope the codebase and write one ready-to-execute plan before coding.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want the plan settled before touching any code.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会以「规划顾问」身份工作:先做只读探索与研究,再写出一份不留判断余地的工作计划,保存在 .omo/ 下。它绝不改动产品代码、也不派子代理去实现;动手前会给你一份确认简报,等你明确同意后才落笔写计划。
howto.when: 只在你明确要求 ulw-plan 工作流、或要求在写代码前先出一份计划时接管;单独运行 ulw 不会自动触发。会话开头会先打印 ULW-PLAN MODE ENABLED 标记,并公布 CLEAR/UNCLEAR 判定。

say.text: 用 ulw-plan 给我出一份实现计划,先别动代码
say.note: 进入规划模式,先探索再出计划

say.text: 我要给 /login 加 5 次/分钟限流,先规划怎么做
say.note: 判定 CLEAR,只问真正需要你拍板的岔路

say.text: 这份计划要高精度评审

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude works as a planning consultant: it explores read-only, then writes one decision-complete plan under .omo/. It never edits product code or delegates implementation, and waits for your okay before writing.
howto.when_en: It activates only on an explicit request for the ulw-plan workflow or for a plan before coding; a bare ulw run never triggers it. It prints the ULW-PLAN MODE ENABLED marker first.

say_en.text: Use ulw-plan to write an implementation plan; don't code yet
say_en.note: Enters plan mode: explore, then plan

say_en.text: I want a 5-per-minute per-IP rate limit on /login - plan it first
say_en.note: Routes CLEAR, asks only real forks
Sets review_required; runs plan-reviewer after the plan
